answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation with a crystal-clear reputation graph: every agent locks a deposit at a vertex of trust, and peers only countersign work from vertices with proven history. A fake identity starts isolated, so its false attestations cannot ripple outward - the graph simply has no edges to carry them. When abuse is proven, the deposit at that vertex is slashed and redistributed to victims, making clone farms pay more than they earn.
